g.text: 18. gap (left): the field engine, rung 0, "base", seed 2, 189.25 s to 210 s
in the front rank, the slot on his left exists and is empty. Men: 114. Body: hastati, second century.
+ a slot, joined to its man when he is away from it · □ the standard · ○ the men the flag is about · red line: a bout
